title: ShopLite CrashLoopBackOff — startup failing due to missing env var
description: All shoplite pods are in CrashLoopBackOff. Containers exit with code 1 immediately after startup. Logs show 'REQUIRED_SECRET env var is not set — startup aborted'. The deploy workflow was run with break_config=true, which omitted the Kubernetes Secret containing REQUIRED_SECRET. FAULT=bad_config is active.
